title: A mushroom snack that hits the mark in flavor and texture
body: As a mycophile, one would think I’d love mushroom snacks, but sadly most have left a literal bad taste in my mouth. But Pan’s Zesty Thai is by far the best mushroom-based snack I’ve tasted, with a very toothsome jerky-like texture that delivers umami-rich flavor with every bite (my wife found it a bit to chewy, but she’s never had real beef jerky due to growing up vegetarian.) Regardless of preference in texture, we both agreed the taste is AAA+

title: A Tasty Treat!
body: I discovered these wonderful jerky treats years ago and then forgot about them until I received an email about a sale. I decided to try them out again and ordered some...they're just as good as I remember! The flavor is great but not overwhelming and they're texture is very similar to, well...jerky, lol. I let my coworkers try them and they were amazed. Several went straight to mushroomjerky.com to order some! Everyone needs to try these, they're a rare and tasty treat!

title: Lemongrass Mushroom Jerky Hits the Spot
body: I've used lemongrass a lot in my cooking so the Lemongrass Mushroom Jerky was something my family had to try. Well, it definitely lived up to the expectations.
